channel.title: Steam Games on Chasing Dings!
channel.description: Recent content in Steam Games on Chasing Dings!

item.title: Blasts from the Past: Is it the 90s again?
item.description: Quick reviews of Rakuraku Dinokun, Terminal, 8-Colors Space Guardians and Pool of Madness Playtest.

item.title: Preview: Topdeck Automat
item.description: A fun, quick engine building card battler that has you as a humble printer bot single-handedly battling an alien invasion. As one does.

item.title: Review: The Invincible
item.description: A moody mystery set on an dead planet with immense ruins and the power to steal memories.

item.title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy
item.description: Mix X-COM with Mötley Crüe and this is what you get – a hair metal band on its way to its first gig… if they can get by all the haters.

item.title: Steam Next Fest: Windrose, Tides of Blazefall, Twilight Imperium, Panzer Dragoon Zwei
item.description: Short takes to finish out the last of the games I played as part of the Steam Next Fest.

item.title: Steam Next Fest: Scriptorium, Forbidden Solitaire, Don't Panic! It is Just Turbulence
item.description: Two more games from Steam Next Fest. Neither is quite what you might expect. I would have liked to have been able to play a third, Don’t Panic! It is Just Turbulence, but, well…

item.title: Steam Next Fest: MMO98 and Data Center
item.description: These two games are related – promise. Picture BTW is of the actual EverQuest server room.

item.title: Steam Next Fest: Underkeep and Dverghold
item.description: Return to the days of Dungeon Hack, Wizardry and The Eye of the Beholder with these two new dungeon crawlers from Steam Next Fest.

item.title: Dominus Automa: An Idle MMO for Busy Dads
item.description: Someday it’ll be an offline MMO for those with busy lives who want to text sweet nothings to their player character. Someday.

item.title: Erenshor v0.3: "Rising Shadows"
item.description: I hit max level in Erenshor, and BurgeeMedia immediately drops a whole new update full of cool stuff. Coincidence? Maybe!
